text:
Maria H: quick heads-up — the onboarding runbook's 'runtime caching' anchor is returning a 404 from the new nav update. saw this in a user report just now. anyone own that page?
Ben C: ugh, I think that page got moved during the sidebar tidy last week. pinging docs owners who touched it: @Rika @Sam (infra)
Rika: I touched the nav earlier but didn't move that anchor intentionally. can you paste the broken link?
Maria H: sure — the link in the quickstart points to https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kv-cache but it should be https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kv-cache-optimization (or the anchor changed).  
Sam (infra): thanks. I can do a tiny redirect or re-add the old anchor. prefer edit vs redirect? :thinking_face:
Ben C: small edit is fine — keep old anchor as alias if possible. low risk.
Jess: if someone is going to PR, please add a tiny note in the changelog so customers on older quickstarts aren't confused.
Maria H: I opened a tiny PR for the runbook fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12388 — adds the old anchor and updates the quickstart link. PTAL.
Ben C: looking... lgtm except one nit in the markdown spacing. will send review in a sec. :thumbsup:
Rika: if you want me to merge after Ben's review I can. also adding a `docs:owner` label to this repo so we can track these quickfixes.
Sam (infra): for visibility, can we add a grep in the CI spotcheck to catch moved anchors next week? small script suggestion: 
```
# find markdown links that 404 inside docs site (dev only)
rg "\]\(https?://docs.redwood.ai" -n | xargs -I{} curl -sSfL {} || echo "broken"
```
Maria H: thanks — I'll add a follow-up ticket for an anchor smokecheck.
docs-bot: reminder: please include `#docs` and `#owner` labels for PRs touching runbooks.
Jess: good call. Ben left a tiny inline request. Ben C: updated review — sorry, pedantic space. once that's fixed, go ahead and merge.
Maria H: fixed and force-pushed. merging now. thanks all. :rocket:
Rika: nice — can someone drop the PR link into the internal incident tracker entry so support folks see the fix?
Maria H: done: INC-4821 comment updated with the PR link. closing thread once CI passes.
Ben C: CI passed. :white_check_mark: merged.
Maria H: thanks team. leaving a quick note in the docs owners spreadsheet about nav drift so we can spot recurring moves.
Jess: yay, small win. lunch? :salad:
